about.title: About
about.text: Hello! My name is Paulo Henrique, I’m 21 years old, and I’m a Full Stack Developer with a technical degree in Web Development from SENAC Lapa Tito. I also completed the PROPROFISSÃO - Web Development with Python program at Instituto PROA, focused on preparing young people for the job market. Currently, I’m pursuing a technical degree in Artificial Intelligence at SENAC Lapa Tito and working as an Apprentice at Nubank, where I have the opportunity to learn in an environment driven by technology and innovation. I have experience with technologies such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and SQL. I also have experience working as a Scrum Master and Full Stack Developer on the DunDum project, combining technical development with team organization. My main goal is to continue growing in the technology field, taking on new challenges, expanding my knowledge, and contributing to the teams and projects I am part of. Want to see my work?
